scope_note: Every figure on this page is computed over that scope only, before any grouping.
scope_none_body: Your account currently governs nobody. Ask an administrator to widen your scope to see these analyses.
kp_subtitle: The capabilities exactly one person carries — by name, with their site and role.
kp_intro: A skill × org-unit sweep. For every role requirement it compares the required level against the people actually assessed at that level.
kp_band_sole_holder_help: Exactly one person assessed at the required level. This is the key-person risk.
kp_band_no_qualified_help: People were assessed; none reaches the required level. A real, evidenced gap.
kp_band_never_measured_help: Nobody here has ever been assessed on this skill. That is an UNKNOWN, not a gap — it is never counted as risk.
kp_never_measured_note: No assessment to date — unknown, not a gap.
kp_empty_title: No sole holder in this scope
kp_empty_body: No skill required here is carried by a single assessed person. Try "All states" or widen the filter to see unknowns and measured gaps.
kp_empty_never_hint: {n} pairs have never been assessed here: their state is unknown until an assessment happens.
kp_unknown_banner: {n} critical requirements in this scope have never been assessed. They appear as "Never measured" and are deliberately counted neither as covered nor as at risk.
se_subtitle: The sites side by side: readiness, continuity, certifications.
se_intro: One row per site, from the same sources as the detail pages — so the table cannot contradict the page you drill into.
se_readiness_null_help: No requirement assessed at this site — no percentage can be shown.
se_empty_body: Nobody in your scope is attached to a site. As soon as an assignment exists, this table fills in.
bp_subtitle: A print-ready brief for the committee.
bp_no_trend: No recorded history yet. The daily snapshot feeds this section; the first point will appear at the next snapshot.
bp_trend_single: One recorded snapshot only ({a}, {x} %) — no comparison possible yet.
bp_keyperson_hidden: Section reserved for holders of a continuity grant.
bp_no_keyperson: No sole holder identified in this scope.
bp_action_designate: Designate the critical positions still unscored, so succession coverage can be computed.
bp_action_assess: Start assessing the {n} critical requirements never measured — their state is unknown today.
bp_action_bench: Open a succession plan for the {n} sole-holder skills identified (the table above shows an extract only).
bp_action_certs: Handle the {n} certifications expiring within 90 days.
bp_footnote: Figures computed over the stated scope. "Not measured" values are left blank and are never treated as zero.
kp_truncated: This table shows only the first {shown} of the {total} sole-holder skills identified. The full list is under Continuity → Key-person risk.
